LanguageData.FCP_Railroad_Enlist_Button_Desc: Join the Railroad's cause. The pay is modest and the trust is earned slowly, but the work matters.
LanguageData.FCP_Railroad_Enlist_Requrements_Not_Sati: The Railroad doesn't recruit anyone it hasn't had time to trust. Build more standing with them first.
LanguageData.FCP_Railroad_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Faction: {0} won't enlist with a faction your colony is at war with.
LanguageData.FCP_Railroad_Missions_Desc: Accept taskings from the Railroad and collect payment once they're finished.
LanguageData.FCP_Railroad_Salary_Desc: A modest cut of whatever the Railroad can spare, paid out of a treasury that never has quite enough in it.
LanguageData.FCP_Railroad_Storage_Desc: Store and withdraw goods from the Railroad's own caches.
LanguageData.FCP_Railroad_LineRunning_Desc: Learn the routes and the tradecraft that keep the line moving. Builds Social and Intellectual skill over time.
LanguageData.FCP_Railroad_FieldOps_Desc: Drill with the Railroad's field operatives. Builds Shooting and Melee skill over time.
LanguageData.FCP_Railroad_Medic_Desc: Tend to caravan members with whatever medicine the safehouse has on hand.
LanguageData.FCP_Railroad_Resign_Menu_Text: Resigning ends your standing with the Railroad immediately. Are you sure?
LanguageData.FCP_Railroad_Resign_Button_Desc: End your standing with the Railroad. They'll assume you have your reasons.
LanguageData.FCP_Railroad_Reinforcements_Button_Desc: Call in Railroad operatives to assist against a nearby threat, at a cost to your standing.
